answers.core: The **AudioStreamMP3** function is part of the Godot core, and this has a direct impact on the results of the **play()** function. It seems complicated to me to make it a library if Godot itself doesn't directly return errors related to mp3 file playback.
answers.workaround: I haven't found a way around this problem.

title: Add return error to the function play() of AudioStreamMP3.new()
